description: Kubernetes OpenConsole (LOG_FORMAT=ecs): decode the JSON line (no grok) and route audit / application records to logs-openconsole.audit-* / logs-openconsole.app-*. Lines from other containers are left alone. Handles the nested format (2.16.2+) and the dotted one (2.16.1). See deploy/elk/README.md.

'openconsole.audit' : 'openconsole.app'; ctx.event.dataset = ds; } if (ds == 'openconsole.audit') { if (ctx.event.kind == null) { ctx.event.kind = 'event'; } if (ctx.event.outcome == null) { String a = ctx.event.action instanceof String ? ctx.event.action : ''; if (a.endsWith('.success')) { ctx.event.outcome = 'success'; } else if (a.endsWith('.failed') || a.endsWith('.denied') || a.endsWith('.rate_limited') || a.endsWith('.locked')) { ctx.event.outcome = 'failure'; } } }
